name: v2.66.0 (2026-11-04)
body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 7d1d3f0191fd5d500b02e58dee2bf6d7adc1b967 -->

## What's Changed
### 🛡️ Security
* [GHSA-m5vj-8mcw-82qx](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/security/advisories/GHSA-m5vj-8mcw-82qx) (high): `web_fetch_tool` and the `WebFetch` capability's local fallback re-indented a JSON response on the event loop before applying the returned-content limit, so a deeply nested document within the download size limit could expand to hundreds of times its size, using large amounts of memory and delaying other work in the same process. You are affected if an attacker can choose or influence the URLs the tool fetches. Provider-native web fetching is not affected. Fixed in v2.66.0 and v1.107.10 (`pydantic-ai`, `pydantic-ai-slim`).
* [GHSA-mfx5-pc32-32m8](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/security/advisories/GHSA-mfx5-pc32-32m8) (high): The `private_key` pattern in Pydantic AI Harness's secret redaction backtracked exponentially on crafted text, so a few hundred characters that begin like a private key could occupy the event loop for minutes or longer. You are affected if you use `redact_secrets` or `secret_data()` with the `private_key` pattern, which is included by default, on text an attacker can influence. Fixed in `pydantic-ai-harness` 0.66.0.
* [GHSA-5fj9-5pjw-vpwc](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/security/advisories/GHSA-5fj9-5pjw-vpwc) (medium): The cloud-metadata blocklist that URL downloads check did not include Tencent Cloud's instance metadata address `169.254.0.23`, so someone who can supply a URL the application downloads could have it fetch the instance's temporary role credentials. You are affected if you run on Tencent Cloud and allow local URLs, through `force_download='allow-local'` on a `FileUrl` or `web_fetch_tool(allow_local_urls=True)`. Fixed in v2.66.0 and v1.107.10 (`pydantic-ai`, `pydantic-ai-slim`).
* [GHSA-jp94-mmr3-2pvv](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/security/advisories/GHSA-jp94-mmr3-2pvv) (medium): With OpenTelemetry instrumentation enabled for embedding models, embedding spans recorded the `extra_headers` and `extra_body` embedding settings, so credentials passed through them could be read by anyone with access to the exported traces. You are affected if you instrument embedding models and pass secrets through those settings. Fixed in v2.66.0 and v1.107.10 (`pydantic-ai`, `pydantic-ai-slim`). Restrict access to historical traces and rotate credentials they exposed.
* [GHSA-7494-925c-rrxv](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/security/advisories/GHSA-7494-925c-rrxv) (medium): For models whose profile requires tool schemas without `$defs` and `$ref`, a small tool schema whose definitions reference one another repeatedly expanded exponentially when inlined on the event loop, which can take minutes of CPU time and gigabytes of memory. You are affected if you serve such a model through the AG-UI adapter, where clients submit their own frontend tool schemas. Fixed in v2.66.0 and v1.107.10 (`pydantic-ai`, `pydantic-ai-slim`).
* [GHSA-484x-x9m4-62cj](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/security/advisories/GHSA-484x-x9m4-62cj) (medium): Decision models (`DecisionModel` subclasses such as `OpenAIDecisionsModel`, and `TypeSafeModel`) resolved every `$ref` in a tool's argument schema again at each place it appears, so a small crafted schema could take exponential time and memory on the event loop. You are affected if you use a decision model from v2.46.0 onward with tools whose schemas an attacker can supply, most directly through an AG-UI endpoint. Fixed in v2.66.0 (`pydantic-ai`, `pydantic-ai-slim`).
* [GHSA-r879-rxgj-3g75](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/security/advisories/GHSA-r879-rxgj-3g75) (medium): The Vercel AI and AG-UI adapters took time that grows with the square of the number of parts to load a submitted message, on the event loop, so a single request could delay other work in the same process. You are affected if you pass client-submitted conversations to `VercelAIAdapter` or `AGUIAdapter`. Fixed in v2.66.0 and v1.107.10 (`pydantic-ai`, `pydantic-ai-slim`).
* [GHSA-4cj4-hgwf-4hc4](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/security/advisories/GHSA-4cj4-hgwf-4hc4) (medium): When message history was serialized and loaded again, a tool result containing a JSON object in the serialized shape of one of Pydantic AI's file types was rebuilt as that file. A third party who controls data a tool returns could use this to make the application download a URL on its local network, or make the model provider read an `s3://` object or uploaded file with the application's credentials. You are affected if tool results can contain data third parties control, that history is stored and reloaded, held on the server by a UI adapter, or carried by Temporal, DBOS or Prefect durable execution, and your model or its provider fetches or resolves such files; the advisory lists which do. Fixed in v2.66.0 and v1.107.10 (`pydantic-ai`, `pydantic-ai-slim`).
* [GHSA-5ppx-9jq6-6pmw](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/security/advisories/GHSA-5ppx-9jq6-6pmw) (low): `allowed_domains` on the local web-fetch tool, and `PlaywrightBrowser` egress policies whose allowlist bounds every request kind, looked a refused hostname up in DNS before rejecting it, so data encoded in the hostname could reach that domain's nameserver. Domain lists are now checked before resolution. You are affected only if you rely on such an allowlist while the model processes content untrusted parties can influence. Fixed in v2.66.0 and v1.107.10 (`pydantic-ai`, `pydantic-ai-slim`), and `pydantic-ai-harness` 0.66.0.
* [GHSA-mgmv-r532-pg36](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/security/advisories/GHSA-mgmv-r532-pg36) (medium): An `MCP` capability configured with a server URL and no explicit `id` derived its identifier from the URL's hostname and last path segment, and the AG-UI and Vercel AI adapters sent that identifier to the frontend with MCP Apps tool results, so a credential in that segment could reach users of the chat frontend. This affects v2.57.0 up to but not including v2.60.0, and was fixed in v2.60.0; it is disclosed with this batch. Rotate MCP server credentials that were carried in the URL path.

### ⚠️ Compatibility Notes
* Call Anthropic's `20260209` web tools directly on the Anthropic API when citations are requested by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12278
* Apply `FunctionToolset(requires_approval=True)` to `Tool` instances passed to the toolset by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12378
* Re-resolve realtime session instructions before each model turn and deliver their changes as appends by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11930
* Recognize `SummarizingCompaction(keep_user_messages=True)` copies only by the marker on their text by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12316

### 🚀 Features
* Add `OpenSandbox` for self-hosted agent workspaces by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11841
* Add Azure Durable Task durability to `pydantic_ai_harness` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11332
* Add `Pixeltable` tools and memory storage to Harness by @pierrebrunelle in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9369
* Add `RenderSandbox` to run agent workspaces in Render sandboxes by @ojusave in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10238
* Add `include_instructions` to the `MCP` capability so server instructions can be left out of the agent's instructions by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12269
* Re-resolve realtime session instructions before each model turn and deliver their changes as appends by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11930
* Report xAI Grok Voice speech timing as `segment` timestamps with `output_speech_timestamps` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11782
* Add a `retries` field to `SummarizingCompaction` by @gouyu-hou in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12315
* Add `Workspace.authority` and `AuthorityWorkspace` for workspaces whose files the operator does not control by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11836
### 🐛 Bug Fixes
* Stop `ModalSandbox` failing with `AttributeError` on Modal 1.6, which removed `FilesystemExecutionError` by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12247
* Call Anthropic's `20260209` web tools directly on the Anthropic API when citations are requested by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12278
* Add streaming support to `CohereModel` by @Julien-ser in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/6100
* Release run dependencies after exceptions by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11255
* Preserve extra keys in `tool_search` and `load_capability` message history by [@pydanty](https://github.com/apps/pydanty) in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/7933
* Inline `$defs` in tool schemas for GLM-5.3 on Together, Nebius, Fireworks, Vercel, Ollama, Hugging Face, Cerebras, Mistral and OpenAI-compatible gateways by [@pydanty](https://github.com/apps/pydanty) in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12138
* Keep `RepoContext` from following symlinks out of the working directory or to files that aren't instruction files by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12044
* Reject approvals for tool calls a server-held history isn't waiting on under `manage_message_history='server'` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12313
* Apply `FunctionToolset(requires_approval=True)` to `Tool` instances passed to the toolset by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12378
* Recognize `SummarizingCompaction(keep_user_messages=True)` copies only by the marker on their text by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12316
* Keep on-demand capabilities loaded from code across `SummarizingCompaction`, `SlidingWindowCompaction` and `RelevanceCompaction`, recording every removed load again as a `CapabilityLoadDeltaPart` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12270
* Keep earlier tool-call turns byte-stable when a later response thinks in `openai_chat_send_back_thinking_parts='field'` mode by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12309
* Keep a code-loaded capability's instructions across instruction windows by [@pydanty](https://github.com/apps/pydanty) in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12304
* Write `RepairToolArguments` repairs back to the `ToolCallPart` in history by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12319
* Take user constraints only from the user's messages in `AnthropicModel.compact_messages()`'s focus prompt by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11915
* Floor the tiered escalation estimate at the surviving text so a cheap anchor cannot hide the rest of the chain by @gouyu-hou in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12341
* Close `SqliteStepStore` and `SqliteMediaStore` connections whose WAL switch fails on a locked database by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12147
* Fix instrumented embedding spans missing the `embeddings` attribute when `include_content=True` by [@pydanty](https://github.com/apps/pydanty) in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8295
* Stop keying `OpenAIChatModel`'s batch hint, OpenAI realtime models and harness `Advisor` on provider names by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11796

## New Contributors
* @pierrebrunelle made their first contribution in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9369
* @Patrick-SCH03 made their first contribution in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8332
* @gouyu-hou made their first contribution in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12315

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/compare/v2.65.0...v2.66.0

name: v2.65.0 (2026-11-02)
body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at a56a6d6f138d1e3a9c45a9697ea513bef47a6cea -->

## What's Changed
### ⚠️ Compatibility Notes
* Protect the `gh-aw` canonical session capture from agent tools by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10606
* Add multimodal notes to `AskUserAnswer` by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11664
* Count `BrowserUse` model calls toward the host run's usage and `UsageLimits` by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11860
* Name the V2 replacement when code imports a name V2 removed, like `OpenAIModel` or `MCPServerStdio` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12035
* Fall back to the next model in `ModelFallback` when a model refuses, and let `ContentFilterError` in `fallback_on` match refusals by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12039
* Raise `ModelQuotaExceededError` instead of `ModelRateLimitError` for Z.ai balance and plan-limit 429s by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12042
* Support the `'12h'` prompt cache retention on the OpenAI Responses API for GPT-5.6 and later by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12046
* Send Google a server deadline of at least 20 minutes instead of the client's read timeout, and warn about httpx's 5 s default by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12057
* Stop Temporal from retrying model errors that can't succeed on retry by default, via `non_retryable_model_errors` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12107
### 🚀 Features
* Add WebSocket transport to OpenAI Responses by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10444
* Add `ConversationStore`, which keeps a conversation as a log of messages stored once, and `Conversation.revision` to catch conflicting saves by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10658
* Add multimodal notes to `AskUserAnswer` by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11664
* Add `anthropic_web_tools_allowed_callers` to set `allowed_callers` on Anthropic's web tools by @aweis89 in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10489
* Support the `'12h'` prompt cache retention on the OpenAI Responses API for GPT-5.6 and later by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12046
* Send mid-conversation system prompts natively on OpenRouter OpenAI routes and the Claude models that support them by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12056
* Name the V2 replacement when code imports a name V2 removed, like `OpenAIModel` or `MCPServerStdio` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12035
* Fall back to the next model in `ModelFallback` when a model refuses, and let `ContentFilterError` in `fallback_on` match refusals by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12039
### 🐛 Bug Fixes
* Raise `ModelContextWindowExceededError` and `ModelQuotaExceededError` for Bedrock errors on `AsyncAnthropicBedrock` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12040
* Raise `ContentFilterError` instead of `TypeError` when Azure filters a streamed `OpenAIChatModel` prompt by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12041
* Re-surface nested `RepoContext` instruction files after compaction, and stop repeating notes still in history by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11704
* Include the refusal text in `ContentFilterError` when the provider also reports a finish reason by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12036
* Raise `ModelQuotaExceededError` instead of `ModelRateLimitError` for Z.ai balance and plan-limit 429s by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12042
* Protect the `gh-aw` canonical session capture from agent tools by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10606
* Close `PlaywrightBrowser`'s Chromium and driver when an `anyio` scope cancels a run by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12047
* Ask `Coder` to match the surrounding code's style instead of applying SOLID by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12120
* Return a `Coder` tool's error to the model once its retries run out instead of ending the run by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12121
* Keep `*args` and `**kwargs` docstring descriptions on tool parameters by @Aryapatel-007 in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12126
* Read tool parameter descriptions from `Keyword Args` and `Other Parameters` docstring sections by @roydonsequeira in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10035
* Let a retired `aws_lambda` agent loop finish its own cleanup at the grace deadline by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12140
* Treat `auth=''` as unset alongside `client` in `GitHub`, `Notion`, `Ordinal`, `PostHog`, `Pylon`, and `Slack` by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11852
* Count `BrowserUse` model calls toward the host run's usage and `UsageLimits` by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11860
* Let `FileSystem` tools emit their events under `PrefixTools` by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11867
* Forward `cache='1h'` to Claude Haiku 5.5 on Bedrock instead of snapping it to `'5m'` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12045
* Mark `<context>` elements in user and tool content as not from the application by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12050
* Stop Temporal from retrying subclasses of non-retryable errors, like `ContentFilterError` or a `UserError` subclass by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12105
* Stop Temporal from retrying model errors that can't succeed on retry by default, via `non_retryable_model_errors` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12107
* Stop sending a history container on Anthropic requests without code execution by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11764
* Send Google a server deadline of at least 20 minutes instead of the client's read timeout, and warn about httpx's 5 s default by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12057
* Place the OpenRouter Gemini message cache breakpoint before the final message, where it no longer doubles the billed prompt by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12048
### 📦 Dependencies
* Remove the Daytona `close()` workaround and require `daytona>=0.226.1` by @mislavivanda in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11977

## New Contributors
* @Aryapatel-007 made their first contribution in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12126
* @roydonsequeira made their first contribution in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10035
* @mislavivanda made their first contribution in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11977

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/compare/v2.64.0...v2.65.0

name: v2.64.0 (2026-10-30)
body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at cde1d10f88ce6d0ab4743e226d51a9ac65810f50 -->

## What's Changed
### ⚠️ Compatibility Notes
* Raise an error status a retrying transport gave up on as `ModelHTTPError`, so fallback moves on by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11934
* Send stored response, item, conversation and container IDs back only to the endpoint that created them, via `Model.accepts_server_state` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11774
* Make `json-repair` an optional dependency, needed only by `Coder` and `RepairToolArguments` by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11768
* Turn off strict tool schemas for `Coder`'s tools by default, with `Coder(strict=True)` to opt in by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11743
* Surface every nested `RepoContext` instruction file between a traversed path and the working directory, without repeating the root file by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11687
* Add `output_speech_timestamps` to report word timing of realtime speech, on Azure AI Voice Live by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11685
* Make the `ModelFallback` capability constructible from agent specs by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11679
* Add a `first_event_timeout` model setting so a stream that never starts can fall back by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11582

* Add a `ModelFallback` capability, a per-attempt `prepare_model_request` hook, and `RetryModelRequest` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9348
* Add Harness `Reminder(scope='conversation')` for reminders that stay in the message history by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11642
* Add `output_speech_timestamps` to report word timing of realtime speech, on Azure AI Voice Live by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11685
* Cache the schema of `ModelRequestContext` durable capability operations across agent construction by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11776
* Make the `ModelFallback` capability constructible from agent specs by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11679

* Record CI provenance on Pydantic Evals experiment spans with OpenTelemetry `vcs.*` and `cicd.*` attributes by @dmontagu in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10294
* Accept plain functions as evaluators in `pydantic_evals` by @dmontagu in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10292
* Add `logfire.scorer.score_type` and `logfire.scorer.run_id` to online evaluation result events by @dmontagu in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10293
* Add the OpenTelemetry `test.suite.name` and `test.case.name` attributes to Pydantic Evals spans by @dmontagu in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11538
* Turn off strict tool schemas for `Coder`'s tools by default, with `Coder(strict=True)` to opt in by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11743
* Make `json-repair` an optional dependency, needed only by `Coder` and `RepairToolArguments` by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11768
* Teach `Coder` to read what the task names, check stated requirements, and delegate only when asked by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11811
* Let `AskUser` answerers receive `RunContext` by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11662
* Add agent artifact security scanning for `Memory` and `Skills` with `ArtifactScanner` by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11470

* Save function evaluators to `Dataset` files under the function's name by @dmontagu in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10425
* State how nested instruction files relate in `RepoContext` instructions when `nested_traversal` is on by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11698
* Add a `first_event_timeout` model setting so a stream that never starts can fall back by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11582

* Keep the Gemini Live event stream alive when a resumed session lost a tool call without an id by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11680

* Show the harness `Planning` plan in the plan tools' results instead of a per-request reminder copy by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11521

* Keep the usage and response ID a primed stream received when the consumer leaves it without iterating by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11783
* Keep `Shell`'s job files in a private temp directory when the workspace isn't writable by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11809
* Inline `$ref`s under `propertyNames` and `contains` for OpenRouter Google models and custom `prefer_inlined_defs` transformers by @jukebox in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10859
* Strip regex patterns Bedrock rejects from strict JSON schemas in `BedrockJsonSchemaTransformer` by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11831
* Remove unresolvable `RealtimeEvent` from `pydantic_ai.agent.__all__` by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10189
* Keep finished `BackgroundTools` results in the history when a run pauses for deferred tools by @wangrat in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11752
* Let `FileSystem` `edit_file` edit non-UTF-8 text files that `read_file` reads, honoring `expected_hash` by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11851
* Make `SubAgents` children that share usage run under the parent's `usage_limits` by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11853
* Publish `AgentSpec` schema fields for `Advisor`, `SummarizingCompaction`, `ManagedPrompt` and `PyaiDocs` by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11857
* Let an `asyncpg` pool type-check as `PostgresMemoryStore`'s `PostgresPool` by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11856
* Let capability specs set the `AbstractCapability` base fields `id`, `description` and `defer_loading` by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11858
* Publish `AgentSpec` schema fields for `CodeMode`, `ModalSandbox`, and `Skills` by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11859

* Fix capability events emitted from tools under `prefix_tools()` by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11863
* Make V1-style `result.usage()` warn instead of raising `TypeError` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11884
* Accept list-typed `content` from OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions servers by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11885
* Don't show the first-run banner for runs an installed package starts by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11893
* Stop waiting for a stalled `BedrockConverseModel` call or stream read when its request is cancelled or times out by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11850
* Mark request-scoped `SystemPromptPart`s `visible: false` in OTel spans of requests the model no longer sees them on by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11772
* Send stored response, item, conversation and container IDs back only to the endpoint that created them, via `Model.accepts_server_state` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11774
* End tool results before a mid-conversation `system` entry on Claude Haiku 5.5, so it doesn't read the entry as tool output by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11785
* Carry `ModelResponse.canonical_system` through Vercel AI and AG-UI message round-trips by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11794
* Judge each attempt's model in `FileUnderstanding`, and let `prepare_model_request` persist history changes by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11802
* Report no audio input for OpenAI's non-audio models and no video input on Bedrock outside Nova by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11812

<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at e2fbcf609852600e2f2e2eabb18c0b233c49a937 -->

## What's Changed
### ⚠️ Compatibility Notes
* Default `CodeMode` to `dynamic_catalog=True`, so a revealed tool is appended instead of rewriting the cached prompt by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11358
* Pass the Gemini Live reconnect replay to `GoogleRealtimeConnection`'s `dial` as a keyword-only `replay` argument by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11515
* Give Harness `LLMReminder` a default `interval=10` instead of generating on every request by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11641
* Replay signed and encrypted history data to providers with the same `canonical_system` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11504
* Let a deferred `CombinedCapability` load as one capability, with members keeping their global ordering by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10321
* End a GPT-Live reply that delegated at Live's next pause instead of mid-sentence when the backend answers by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11250
* Say what the `<system>` tag means and escape it in user and tool text on models without mid-conversation system messages by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11506
### 🚀 Features
* Add `task_timeout` to `Dataset.evaluate` to bound each task attempt by @dmontagu in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10291
* Support `ag-ui-protocol` 1.0 by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8627
* Default `CodeMode` to `dynamic_catalog=True`, so a revealed tool is appended instead of rewriting the cached prompt by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11358
* Pass the Gemini Live reconnect replay to `GoogleRealtimeConnection`'s `dial` as a keyword-only `replay` argument by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11515
* Add OpenAI `gpt-6.1-terra` model support by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11393
* Add an IPython Code Mode (`IPythonCodeMode`) alongside the Monty-based `CodeMode` by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11570
* Give Harness `LLMReminder` a default `interval=10` instead of generating on every request by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11641
* Add a `DetectLoops` capability to interrupt repeated-action loops by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11471
* Add `manage_message_history` to UI adapters so a server-held history isn't sent to the model twice by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11431
* Keep strict schemas within Anthropic's and OpenAI's complexity limits, falling back to non-strict output where no mode was chosen by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11464
* Add a public `pydantic_ai.framing` module with `wrap`, `neutralize_tags` and `register_tag`, so extensions can frame their own tags by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10957
* Replay signed and encrypted history data to providers with the same `canonical_system` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11504
* Add `PostgresSpendStore` so harness `SpendLimits` budgets can be shared through PostgreSQL by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11527
### 🐛 Bug Fixes
* Let a deferred `CombinedCapability` load as one capability, with members keeping their global ordering by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10321
* List the modules Monty 1.2-1.4 added in the `CodeMode` `run_code` description by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11459
* Require `mistralai>=3.1.0` and drop the legacy `httpx` import so `MistralModel` imports on fresh installs by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11549
* Keep the rate-limit category of Azure `too_many_requests` Responses failures on `openai>=3.32.0` by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11532
* Run `ToolOutputLimits` spill writes in a `durable_operation` so replays do not write them again by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11460
* Record the instructions a `before_model_request` hook sent when it rewrote the history with a copy of the request by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11501
* State a deferred capability's instructions on the request where a `before_model_request` hook loaded it by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11516
* Escape framing tags consistently in `BackgroundTools`, `RepoContext`, `TrajectoryJudge` and `Planning` frames by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11530
* Record a `thinking` change after an unanswered `ModelSettingsDeltaPart` instead of replacing it, so UI streams and hook-rebuilt requests keep it by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11514
* Make typed turns on Gemini `gemini-robotics-er` realtime models see the image sent just before them by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11484
* End a GPT-Live WebRTC sideband session cleanly when the browser hangs up by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11435
* End a GPT-Live reply that delegated at Live's next pause instead of mid-sentence when the backend answers by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11250
* Withdraw a pending batch request when the run doesn't end with its `PendingModelResponse` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11517
* Send per-message effort changes through `AsyncAnthropicBedrockMantle` on Claude Opus 5.5 by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11486
* Enable thinking-block binding recovery on `AsyncAnthropicBedrockMantle` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11487
* Stop offering `AdvisorTool` on `AsyncAnthropicBedrockMantle`, which rejects it by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11488
* Keep the stored `CodeMode` REPL state when `repl_store` load fails, instead of saving a fresh REPL over it by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11483
* Fix `RuntimeError: coroutine ignored GeneratorExit` and an escaping `KeyboardInterrupt` on `Agent.iter()` teardown by [@pydanty](https://github.com/apps/pydanty) in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10258
* Return a `wrap_run` or `on_run_error` recovery result from `run_stream()` instead of raising `AgentRunError` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11571
* Say what the `<system>` tag means and escape it in user and tool text on models without mid-conversation system messages by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11506
* Escape framing tags consistently in the `SummarizingCompaction` summarizer transcript by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11583
* Enforce `allowed_patterns` on the real path when `search_files` targets a single symlinked file by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11639
* Normalize bare `None` type arguments in `Dataset` by [@pydanty](https://github.com/apps/pydanty) in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11254
* Stop offering `WebSearchTool` and `WebFetchTool` on `AsyncAnthropicBedrockMantle`, which rejects them by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11489
* Don't commit an automatic `SummarizingCompaction` summary that would make the history larger by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11649
* Clear the caption in `stream_transcripts(delta=True)` when a transcript is corrected to empty by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11667
* Evaluate runs with every `OnlineEvaluation` capability on an agent, not just the outermost by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11663
* Omit realtime span `model_settings` when `include_content=False` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11668
* Call `AsyncAnthropicBedrockMantle` the Bedrock Messages API, not Claude Platform on AWS, in comments and docstrings by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11482
* Record the provider item ID on the model's realtime `SpeechPart.id` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11675

<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 79685d18af7c8ea174029f23f40eec7c4af18e2b -->

## What's Changed
### ⚠️ Compatibility Notes
* Change thinking effort mid-conversation via OpenAI `configuration_update` and Anthropic per-message `output_config`, recorded as `ModelSettingsDeltaPart` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11111
* Add `ModelRequestRejectedError`, `ModelAuthenticationError` and `ModelNotFoundError` model error categories by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11081
* State loaded deferred capabilities' instructions in the system voice, append their changes, and show them to `before_model_request` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11103
* Prefix hosted MCP capabilities' tool names with the service by default, configurable with `tool_prefix` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10376
* Store the `SummarizingCompaction` summary as a `CompactionPart` instead of a system prompt, and send provider-less `CompactionPart`s to every model by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10573
* Deliver realtime `SystemPromptPart`s on each provider's operator channel with `session.send()` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11379
* Preserve run identity when replaying Prefect capability operations by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11196
* Append changed MCP server instructions with `on_change='append'`, and give an id-less URL `MCPToolset` its hostname as `id` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10791
* Record Harness `Memory` snapshots in history once per changed run, so requests stay append-only by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10903
* Tell the realtime model a tool call failed on every provider, so it answers instead of going silent by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11086
* Reserve DBOS handler step positions during tool `ctx.emit()` by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11157
* Record GPT-Live speech as one `SpeechPart` instead of splitting it at each delegated tool call by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11187
* Deliver `ctx.emit()` events into the realtime session event stream by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11369
* Make realtime shared settings warn, raise or ignore like standard `ModelSettings`: forced `tool_choice` raises on Gemini Live, `parallel_tool_calls=False` warns by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11066
* Keep the prompt cache when changing thinking effort mid-conversation on OpenRouter, via its `configuration_update` system message by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11426

## What's Changed
### ⚠️ Compatibility Notes
* Warn when a provider-specific thinking setting from a broader scope overrides `thinking` by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10231
* Send the least thinking a model accepts for `thinking=False` on models that can't turn thinking off by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11036
* Raise `NotImplementedError` for a file in a `CohereModel` tool return instead of dropping it by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11114
* Keep concurrent workspace runs attached to their own Prefect environments by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11160
* Keep `bool` and `int` inputs on separate `Literal` decision branches in `pydantic_graph` by @dafyy321-pixel in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9091
* Deprecate `google_multi_speaker` on `GoogleRealtimeModel`, which no Gemini Live model supports by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11064
* Accept async `auth` functions in the hosted MCP capabilities by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10835
* Run the authoring checks in `CapabilityStore.load_active` and stop overwriting unreadable manifests by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10731
* Keep the last valid authored capability on a failed re-author, share the `CapabilityStore` lock per directory, and let runs cancel authoring by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10767
* Reject `BrowserUse` prohibited lists browser-use would match by exact hostname, and retry when redacted schema keys collide by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10775
* Share one `LocalStack` container inside `async with agent:`, stop service-list bypasses and `aws configure` writes to `~/.aws`, and cap `aws_cli` output by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10828
* Make `InputGuardrail` redact the user's own prompt and close fail-open paths in guardrails by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10841
* Keep `CodeMode(dynamic_catalog=True)` discoveries from rewriting the cached prompt by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10906
### 🚀 Features
* Accept async `auth` functions in the hosted MCP capabilities by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10835
* Add structured citations to `TextPart` by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/7434
* Normalize citations from Bedrock, OpenRouter, and xAI by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/7750
* Bound background and `shell` job logs with `Shell.max_log_bytes` by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10712
* Replay citations in message history to the provider that produced them by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/7752
* Keep citations in the Vercel AI adapter by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9639
* Add `kimi-k3.1-pro` and `kimi-k3.1-pro-highspeed` model names by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11173
* Accept `transport=` in `create_async_httpx2_client()` and give the `httpx2` retry transports its pool limits by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11073
* Add `RealtimeClientSecret.webrtc_url`, which carries `webrtcfilter=on` on Azure OpenAI by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11076
* Warn when a realtime session has capabilities that implement hooks it never calls by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11094
* Add `RealtimeModelProfile.supports_audio_output` so text-only realtime models like Gemini's robotics streaming models default to text output by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11102
* Make the durable engine extension surface public: operation types, `ParameterTransports`, `DurableRunContext` and run identity hooks by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11088
### 🐛 Bug Fixes
* Keep streamed OpenRouter `reasoning` that arrives without `reasoning_details` by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11104
* Raise a `UserError` instead of an `AssertionError` for an unconverted response `SpeechPart` in `BedrockConverseModel` by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11107
* Raise `NotImplementedError` for a file in a `CohereModel` tool return instead of dropping it by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11114
* Detect pydantic-ai-minted Gemini tool-call ids with `TOOL_CALL_ID_PREFIX` instead of a hardcoded `'pyd_ai_'` by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11109
* Keep `bool` and `int` inputs on separate `Literal` decision branches in `pydantic_graph` by @dafyy321-pixel in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9091
* Support `NativeOutput` on every `FireworksProvider` model by [@pydanty](https://github.com/apps/pydanty) in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10157
* Warn when a provider-specific thinking setting from a broader scope overrides `thinking` by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10231
* Record the failed status on streamed `XaiModel` native tool return parts by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11105
* Keep an `OpenAIChatModel` response with a non-standard `finish_reason` instead of raising `UnexpectedModelBehavior` by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11119
* Make `InputGuardrail` redact the user's own prompt and close fail-open paths in guardrails by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10841

* Keep dict key order in histories the step stores reload, so resumed runs keep the prompt cache by @rscholz98 in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11137

* Name the operation in `E2BSandbox` probe timeouts and validate `env` and `sandbox_timeout` at construction by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10811
* Rebuild the default `ExaSearch` and `ExaAgent` client on a new event loop, and build `ExaAgent`'s once by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10848
* Keep the last valid authored capability on a failed re-author, share the `CapabilityStore` lock per directory, and let runs cancel authoring by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10767
* Stop `ConversationSearch` returning inherited history once per run, and clip excerpts around the matched term by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10749
* Reject `BrowserUse` prohibited lists browser-use would match by exact hostname, and retry when redacted schema keys collide by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10775
* Share one `LocalStack` container inside `async with agent:`, stop service-list bypasses and `aws configure` writes to `~/.aws`, and cap `aws_cli` output by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10828
* Make `InputGuardrail` redaction also rewrite the history prompt when the model was sent a copy, and tighten the guardrails docs by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10852

* Send tool call `arguments` in `HuggingFaceModel` message history by @canblmz1 in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11139

* Store a failed non-streamed `XaiModel` native tool call as a call part and one return part by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11164
* Stop sending a thinking config to `gemini-2.5-flash-image`, which rejects it by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11099
* Point the first-run banner at `logfire-cli wizard --task pydantic-ai` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11069
* Let `OpenAIResponsesModel` force a tool revealed mid-run on models before GPT-5.6 by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10273
* Keep `CodeMode(dynamic_catalog=True)` discoveries from rewriting the cached prompt by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10906

* Let a named `InstructionPart` passed to a run's `instructions` opt into `on_change='append'`, keyed `run:<name>` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10789
* Keep `SummarizingCompaction(keep_user_messages=True)` copies recognized after their request is merged by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10914
* Strip request-level `instructions` from untrusted history in `sanitize_messages` and server-managed UI adapters by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10897
* Send tool returns whose JSON form is a string, like `datetime` and `UUID`, to the model unquoted so restored histories match the first run by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10488
* Keep the ids of instructions a wrapper toolset passes on from the toolsets it wraps by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10909
* Include `settings` and `profile` in model equality and `Model` `repr` by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9474
* Deprecate `OpenAIDecisionsProvider` and let `OpenAIDecisionsModel` take `OpenAIProvider` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10951
* Record every mid-run tool population change as a `ToolAvailabilityDeltaPart` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9405
* Send typed text to the GPT-Live backend as a user turn, so `send(text)` runs the agent's tools by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10960
* Keep tool returns shaped like media markers from breaking `StepPersistence` snapshots, and fix `SqliteMediaStore`, `DiskMediaStore`, `MongoMediaStore` and `S3MediaStore` edge cases by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10834
* Send settings stated by either of two merged `Advisor` capabilities by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10726
* Drop client-supplied `TextContent.metadata` from user prompts in `sanitize_messages` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10943
* Raise `ModelConnectionError` and `ModelTimeoutError` for xAI gRPC connection failures and client timeouts by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11080
* Send the agent's `system_prompt` and seeded history's system prompts to realtime sessions by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11055
* Deliver `SubAgents` background task output as framed `<task_output>` data instead of in a `SystemPromptPart` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10550
* Keep `BrowserUse` secrets on allowlisted sites and out of tool results, and fix allowlist and `file://` gaps by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10771
* Match `FileSystem` denied and read-only patterns case-insensitively, protect `.git` files, and bound reads and Python regex searches by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10825
* Filter `GitHub` tools on `readOnlyHint` under `read_only=True`, reject `'oauth'`, and deprecate plain `http://` URLs by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10815
* Add `'max'` to unified `thinking` effort levels by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10920
### 🚀 Features
* Add `DockerSandbox` harness capability that runs the workspace in a local Docker or Podman container by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9341
* Add BoxLiteSandbox: a local BoxLite micro-VM workspace by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10740
* Let `SmolSandboxBackend` use a VM the application already has by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10882
* Attribute ElevenLabs Agents replies to the text turns they answer by `in_response_to_ids` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10792
* Add the run's output retry count and budget to `ModelSelectionContext` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10836
* Add `ToolDefinition.unless_tool_kind` and `RunContext.tool_name_for_kind`, and give instructions the current step's tools by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10673
* Send a file a tool returns as a note when the model can't read it, with `supports_audio_file_input` and `supported_document_media_types` profile flags by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10476
* Run `gh-aw` `copilot/` models on the `github-copilot:` model and declare `detection-engine: copilot` by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9318
* Add `base_url` and `MOONSHOTAI_BASE_URL` support to `MoonshotAIProvider` by @yanlinf in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10177
* Drop capability reader tools duplicated by `FileSystem` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9410
* Add Bedrock model profile for xAI Grok 4.6 and 4.7 by @ahmed-moubtahij in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8639
* Add `RelevanceCompaction`, which keeps, reduces or drops each older history step by a judge model's ranking by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11026
* Add `SmartSearch` harness capability for plain-English code search with a pluggable judge model by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8977
* Keep streamed model deltas out of durable execution histories by replaying the final response by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10958
* Send `OpenAIDecisionsModel` message history as native Responses input items by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11028
* Add the `FileUnderstanding` capability by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8453
* Let `MCPToolset` take `auth` and `headers` as functions of the run context, so each run connects as its own user by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10846
* Support Temporal continue-as-new in `TemporalDurability` via `continue_as_new` by @YHallouard in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/7312
* Add `lockdown` to `GitHub` to ask GitHub's server to withhold public content from users without push access by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10822
### 🐛 Bug Fixes
* Fix `SetToolMetadata(background=...)` having no effect on `BackgroundTools` by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10613
* Stop a GPT-Live session hanging when a tool in a delegated round raises by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10794
* Raise `ContentFilterError` when Azure blocks a Responses API prompt without `content_filter_result` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10805
* Record what a Gemini Live model says during an asynchronous tool call before the tool's result by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10802
* Send a raised tool's failure to the GPT-Live backend so the delegated round continues by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10868
* Keep an xAI spoken turn going when its server VAD takes back a stop, and end the reply it drops by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10798
* Keep a GPT-Live reply that called tools open until its delegated backend answers, so what Live says meanwhile stays with it by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10847
* Use only the agent's instructions for realtime sessions, never `instructions` recorded in seeded `message_history` by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10896
* Close the Bedrock event stream when a `BedrockConverseModel.request_stream()` context exits, including on cancellation by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10900
* Keep `BedrockConverseModel` message caching readable after a Claude message ending in a document by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10907
* Use explicit `output_type` overloads for `Agent.from_spec` and `Agent.from_file` by @tjkuson in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10886
* Use native structured output on Bedrock for Claude Haiku 5.5, Sonnet 5 and later, and Opus 4.7 and later by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10901
* Tell `CodeMode` models to `import asyncio` before calling `asyncio.gather` by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10913
* Keep continuing an OpenAI response with `openai_previous_response_id` after a call to a tool with a `tool_kind` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10931
* Leave out a request-scoped `SystemPromptPart` that no user message clears, as after a `no_output` retry on Anthropic by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10938
* Stop recording an empty system message in traces for requests with an `InstructionBaselinePart` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10911
* Leave retried tool returns out of `ClearToolResults` and `DeduplicateFileReads` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10932
* Keep a retried tool return's validation errors structured through a `VercelAIAdapter` round-trip by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10933
* Record `pydantic_ai.tool.retry.*` attributes on argument-validation failure spans by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10934
* Hold eager and speculative `CodeMode` tool calls, and a first model request that raises, until a parallel `InputGuardrail` decides by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10365
* Fix cancelled steps, tool metadata key validation, and handler typing in `AWSLambdaDurability` by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10730
* Describe `Grain`'s write tools and treat `Grain(id=None)` as the default `grain` id by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10801
* Emit `AskUserAnsweredEvent` with `failed=True` when the `AskUser` answerer raises by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10725
* Raise the realtime connection failure from `played_audio_bytes` and `wait_for_playback()` instead of a `UserError` once it ended the audio stream by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10940
* Route every core framework tag through `_framing.wrap`, so a `</system>` in an instruction or tool name can't end its block by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10547
* Report `ModelRetry` and `ToolFailed` from execute hooks on `BackgroundTools` calls to the model by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10830
* Accept Unicode spaces in `AskUser` questions and document its timeout, concurrency and tracing behavior by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10755
* Surface an invalid AG-UI resume payload as a `RunError` instead of denying silently by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/7038
* Allow `ToolSearch(strategy='bm25')` on the legacy Bedrock `AsyncAnthropicBedrock` client by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10340
* Send an empty `reasoning_content` on `DeepSeekProvider` tool calls whenever the request thinks by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10350
* Reject `TemplateVariable` and fall back to the code default on invalid templates in `ManagedPrompt`, and correct its docs by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10821
* Refuse non-regular file reads in `ModalSandboxBackend` and log a sandbox created after every caller was cancelled by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10816
* Keep Eleven Realtime turn tracking intact when the model makes parallel tool calls by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10944
* Report Azure Voice Live `session_output_overflow` as non-recoverable without a reconnect policy by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10947
* Read the context size of an Anthropic server-side tool loop from its last `usage.iterations` pass by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10363
* Wait for GPT-Live's answer to a raised tool's failure before ending the turn by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10941
* Record an xAI realtime reply the user barged in on after it finished generating as interrupted by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10948
* Emit `RealtimeTurnCompleteEvent` once for a realtime turn that ends because a tool raised by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10965
* Honor `retry-after-ms` in `wait_retry_after` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11065
* Send a failure result to Gemini Live when a realtime tool raises, so the session keeps answering by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10942
* Stop OpenAI GPT-Live `answer_webrtc_offer` from rejecting the profile's audio sample rates by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11049
* Keep an in-flight Anthropic `tool_search` call so the model gets its result instead of searching again by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11058
* Accept an explicit `input_transcription_model='auto'` on OpenAI GPT-Live by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11047
* Make `Macroscope` work under durable execution and return the findings of a review the CLI stopped early by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10817
* Treat `LogfireMCP(id=None)` as the default id, accept `client` with `auth=''`, and flag untrusted telemetry in its docs by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10818
* Support `anthropic` 2.x: build message params as dicts and keep Bedrock's `anthropic_version` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11077
* Require `prefect>=3.9.0` so the `prefect` extra imports on current FastAPI by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11071
* Keep `ModelRequest` fields when `WarnNearLimits` strips legacy warnings by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10776
* Show `ApprovalReviewer` and `ToolCallJudge` the arguments as written, and correct the approval reviewer docs by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10727
* Fix command cleanup and first-use races in `BubblewrapWorkspace` by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10746
* Apply `FallbackModel` response handlers when continuing a suspended response by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11085
* Let a Temporal worker register an agent listed on several workflows or also passed to `AgentPlugin` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11082
* Map unified `thinking` to `reasoning.effort` for OpenAI GPT-5.6 and GPT-6 on Bedrock Converse by @rscholz98 in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10993
* Accept unrounded float probabilities and scores from `SystemOneModel` backends like vLLM by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11092
* Keep `SlidingWindowCompaction` and `SummarizingCompaction` histories sendable after tool retries and `keep_messages=0`, and warn on an invalid `summary_prompt` by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10759
* Stop timed-out `E2BSandbox` commands on templates without `ps` by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10809
* Reject `auth='oauth'` and describe only the selected products in `GoogleWorkspace` by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10800
* Handle `prefixItems` and string length bounds in OpenAI strict mode by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/7333
* Make `E2BSandbox` raise a clear `UserError` on Trio before any E2B request by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10810
* Stop `CodeMode` speculation adopting reads that predate a write, scan eager streams that split `\n`, and reject out-of-range `resource_limits` by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10764

* @yanlinf made their first contribution in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10177
* @ahmed-moubtahij made their first contribution in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8639
