name: v2.59.0 (2026-10-20)
body:
> This comment was posted by Codex Desktop using gpt-6.1-sol on behalf of David.

## What's Changed
### 🛡️ Security
* **High — HTML conversion in `web_fetch`:** [GHSA-4whf-38hw-pxxh](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/security/advisories/GHSA-4whf-38hw-pxxh). When `web_fetch_tool` fetched attacker-controlled HTML containing many elements, conversion could delay unrelated work in the same process. Fixed in v2.59.0 and v1.107.9. Upgrade if the tool can fetch such pages.

### ⚠️ Compatibility Notes
* Remove shut-down Groq models `playai-tts`, `playai-tts-arabic`, `meta-llama/llama-guard-4-12b` and `meta-llama/llama-4-maverick-17b-128e-instruct` by @mekanbaymyradov in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10306
* Distinguish omitted provider usage from reported zero and add `UsageLimitUnavailableWarning` by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9491
* Add `on_change='append'` to preserve dynamic instruction prefixes by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8188
* Stop recording that a realtime session ended when a tool raised, and document that it goes on by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10782
* Record what the user heard of ElevenLabs Agents replies they barged in on, adding the `OutputItemCut` lifecycle event by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10739
* Append the next hour to `LogfireMCP` history instead of rewriting its instructions, keeping the prompt cache by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10543
* Settle a realtime reply only with the response that answers it, adding `AnswersRevised` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10668
* Add provider-neutral model error categories like `ModelRateLimitError`, `ModelUnavailableError`, `ModelServerError` and `ModelContextWindowExceededError`, and `ModelHTTPError.for_category` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9354
* Frame `BackgroundTools` results as `<tool_result>` tool output instead of untagged user text by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10548
* Send `TrajectoryJudge` steering as a framework `SystemPromptPart` note plus the judge message as escaped `<judge_feedback>` data, both marked with `metadata` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10545
* Check `tool_calls_limit` before each `CodeMode` nested tool call by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10362
* Let `GitHubCopilotProvider` send a configurable `copilot-integration-id` via `integration_id` or `GITHUB_COPILOT_INTEGRATION_ID` by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10784
### 🚀 Features
* Add `DaytonaSandbox`: a workspace that runs `Coder`, `Shell`, `FileSystem` and every other harness capability in a Daytona sandbox by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10610
* Add `ElevenLabsRealtimeModel` for Eleven Realtime speech-to-speech models by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10738
* Let `FunctionToolset.instructions` and instruction functions opt into `on_change='append'` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10788
* Give `FileSystem` tools registered tool kinds and typed call parts by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10674
* Add `non_retryable_model_errors` to `TemporalDurability` to stop Temporal retrying specific model error categories by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10803
### 🐛 Bug Fixes
* Keep a push-to-talk turn in realtime history when the session ends before the provider confirms its `commit_audio()` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10652
* Accept non-string `metadata` values from OpenAI-compatible chat completions by @dergachoff in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8010
* Record a realtime barge-in's cut in history when `interrupt()` races a failed send, the reply's end, or a later cancel by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10723
* Apply an ElevenLabs Agents `agent_response_correction` only to the message it names by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10709
* Raise for `elevenlabs_agents_llm` and `elevenlabs_agents_tts` `model_id` overrides on ElevenLabs Agents in Realtime voice mode by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10728
* Match OpenAI Realtime audio-commit acknowledgements to the commit that caused them by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10722
* Move unsupported Bedrock array `contains` constraints into descriptions by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10720
* Preserve boolean `$defs` semantics during schema transformation by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10714
* Fix `DynamicWorkflow` revealed type names, nested tool exposure, and empty `WorkflowAgent` descriptions by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10747
* Retry deeply nested `BackgroundTools` optional-tool args instead of raising `RecursionError` by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10721
* Return the value of `BackgroundTools` tools that code mode's `run_code` calls, instead of a started message by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10750
* Schedule a tool once when `BackgroundTools` instances with distinct ids select it by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10757
* Treat `auth=''` as unset alongside `client` in `DayAI` and warn about tokens in Temporal history by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10718
* End an `on_change='append'` window that opened without blocks when a hook unsets `instruction_parts` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10766
* Recognize Bedrock inference profile and foundation model ARNs in `split_bedrock_model_id`, so they get the same model capabilities as the bare ID by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10664
* Render carried thinking as a bare `<assistant_thinking>` tag so UI round trips keep the prompt cache by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10642
* Mark `CodeMode` discovery announcements with `SystemPromptPart.metadata`, and announce a tool again when its announcement was dropped by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10666
* Escape the `SummarizingCompaction` summarizer transcript so tool output can't forge messages by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10544
* Deliver tool-tied `'asap'` enqueue content into the same `ModelRequest` as the tool's `ToolReturnPart` by @divyankmalik in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/7043
* Keep typed `const` constraints, such as `Literal` discriminators, in Anthropic strict schemas by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10675
* Use `<context_diff>` instead of `<context-diff>` for instruction deltas by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10790
* Add the `ToolCallsAbandoned` realtime lifecycle event, so an abandoned tool call no longer holds its exchange open by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10793
* Add `grok-4.7` to xAI known models and Grok reasoning profile by [@pydanty[bot]](https://github.com/apps/pydanty) in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9750
* Let `DeduplicateFileReads` and `ClearToolResults` clear typed `read_file` results again by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10839
* Tie `TrajectoryJudge`'s steering note to its own frame with a `ref`, so forged `<judge_feedback>` tags get no authority by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10869

## New Contributors
* @mekanbaymyradov made their first contribution in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10306
* @dergachoff made their first contribution in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8010
* @divyankmalik made their first contribution in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/7043

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/compare/v2.58.0...v2.59.0

name: v1.107.9 (2026-10-20)
body:
> This comment was posted by Codex Desktop using gpt-6.1-sol on behalf of David.

## What's Changed
### 🛡️ Security
* **High — HTML conversion in `web_fetch`:** [GHSA-4whf-38hw-pxxh](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/security/advisories/GHSA-4whf-38hw-pxxh). When `web_fetch_tool` fetched attacker-controlled HTML containing many elements, conversion could delay unrelated work in the same process. Fixed in v2.59.0 and v1.107.9. Upgrade if the tool can fetch such pages.



**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/compare/v1.107.8...v1.107.9

name: v2.58.0 (2026-10-19)
body:
> This comment was posted by codex-tui using gpt-6.1-sol on behalf of David.

<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at b40096c4c91e4db361ee3f23b0e3f6b85569faa2 -->

## What's Changed
### 🛡️ Security
* **Medium — MCP request telemetry:** [GHSA-xv4x-g8mx-ch56](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/security/advisories/GHSA-xv4x-g8mx-ch56). Provider-native MCP configuration could expose server URLs, authorization tokens and custom header values in OpenTelemetry request traces, even with `include_content=False`. URL-based `MCP` capabilities could also expose a credential embedded in the URL-derived identifier. Fixed in v2.58.0 and v1.107.8. Restrict access to historical traces and rotate exposed credentials.
  **Temporal mitigation:** URL-based `MCP` activity names remain unchanged to preserve in-flight workflows. With Temporal tracing enabled, also pass an explicit `id=` to `MCP` once in-flight workflows complete; changing it renames the activities.
* **Medium — UI adapter history:** [GHSA-5pfm-2g3g-gh85](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/security/advisories/GHSA-5pfm-2g3g-gh85). With non-empty server-side `message_history` and `manage_system_prompt='server'` (the default), Vercel AI and AG-UI adapters could execute an available tool with client-chosen arguments without a model request. Approval-required tools are not executed by this path. Fixed in v2.58.0; v1 is unaffected.
### ⚠️ Compatibility Notes
* Count a resumed `'suspended'` response's usage only in the run that produced it, in `RunUsage`, `UsageLimits` and `SpendLimits` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10078
* Make `RealtimeConnection` yield lifecycle events through a public `pydantic_ai.realtime.lifecycle` module by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10353
* Let `read_file` return images and PDFs, and describe other binary files by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9596
* Record a realtime reply the user cut off after it finished generating as interrupted, and mark interrupted speech when seeding by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10466
* Treat a native tool as unsupported when the model can't apply its `allowed_domains`, `blocked_domains`, `max_uses` or `external_web_access` setting by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10451
* Add request-scoped `SystemPromptPart(scope='request')` sent natively as Anthropic `clear_at` system messages by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9711
* Send Harness `WarnNearLimits` warnings as request-scoped system prompts by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10561
* Escape `RepoContext` `<context-file>` blocks and send the nested-directory pointer as a `SystemPromptPart` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10558
* Make the profile's `supports_auto_cache` decide `anthropic_cache`, and use automatic caching on legacy `AsyncAnthropicBedrock` for Claude Opus 4.7 and later by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10551
* Let any module define a `ToolKind` with typed tool parts, and keep unknown kinds loadable by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9710
* Emit `Planning` status-tool events after their store reads, so DBOS recovery with an `event_stream_handler` replays in order by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10343
  Existing DBOS workflows using `Planning` with an `event_stream_handler` may not recover after upgrading; let in-flight workflows finish first or deploy a new DBOS application version.
* Align `RealtimeTurnCompleteEvent` with the exchange boundary that `wait_for_reply()` waits for by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10517
  To react when a particular response ends, use its `PartEndEvent`s. Caption UIs should keep user parts open until their `PartEndEvent`, which can arrive after the reply completes.
### 🚀 Features
* Steer a running delegated task with `DelegationTasks.steer` by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10359
* Store each message once in `SqliteStepStore` instead of repeating the history in every snapshot by @aweis89 in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9982
* Add `ModelSettings['max_retries']` to set how many times the provider SDK retries a request by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10068
* Bound a whole agent run with `timeout=` and `RunContext.deadline` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10070
* Stream `ctx.enqueue` messages to Vercel AI and AG-UI frontends as history they send back but don't render by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10405
* Add `ModelSettings['request_timeout']` covering all attempts and stream consumption of one model request by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10072
* Store each message once in `PostgresStepStore` and `MongoStepStore` instead of repeating the history in every snapshot by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10452
* Let harness `Skills` ignore `include` and `exclude` names no library has with `unknown_names='skip'` by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10506
* Add the `openai-chatgpt` provider so app users can sign in with ChatGPT and use their plan by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10539
* Accept `timeout=` on UI adapter `run_stream()`, `run_stream_native()` and `dispatch_request()` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10553
* Add `reasoning_summary` to `OpenAILiveResponsesDelegation` to request the GPT-Live backend's reasoning summaries by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10514
* Warn with `UnsupportedSettingWarning` when a model ignores a setting like `timeout`, `max_retries` or `stop_sequences` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10508
* Add `openai_prune_tool_items` to delete answered tool rounds from the OpenAI Realtime conversation by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10556
* Add `ElevenLabsAgentsRealtimeModel` to run realtime sessions on ElevenLabs Agents by @rscholz98 in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/7964
### 🐛 Bug Fixes
* Stop `wait_for_reply()` waiting forever when a realtime tool batch receives no reply after a call is cancelled by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10503
* Label a symlinked `RepoContext` instruction file with its target's name, so `CLAUDE.md -> AGENTS.md` reads `AGENTS.md` by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10438
* Keep mid-run system prompts when `ReinjectSystemPrompt(replace_existing=True)` replaces the client's by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10389
* Keep parallel tool calls in one `ModelResponse` when `VercelAIAdapter` loads messages by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10404
* Stream the returns of tool calls skipped after a final result to AG-UI and Vercel AI frontends by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10409
* Fix `tool_choice='none'` on `BedrockConverseModel` failing after a tool call by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10395
* Resolve the default output mode once per run so toggling `thinking` per step keeps `tools` stable by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10398
* Clear tool results in batches under `ClearToolResults(max_messages=...)` instead of on every request past the threshold by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10390
* Force a single tool natively on `MistralModel` instead of filtering `tools` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10394
* Don't crash on a `CachePoint` after a replayed Anthropic MCP tool result by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10369
* Fall back on stream errors raised before the first event in `FallbackModel` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10386
* Raise in `run_stream()` instead of returning a response that a model request hook rejected with `ModelRetry` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10400
* Give a model's provider a new HTTP client on a new event loop, and keep `Model` instances a selector returns open inside `async with agent:` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10377
* Carry non-native `ThinkingPart`s in a user turn for models that imitate assistant formatting by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/6692
* Send tool-call args as compact JSON from `ToolCallPart.args_as_json_str()` so UI round trips keep the prompt cache by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10410
* Send tool results in call order from `Model.prepare_messages` so UI round trips keep the prompt cache by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10411
* Close the `AsyncInferenceClient` that `HuggingFaceProvider` builds when the provider or agent exits by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10393
* Keep `ToolReturn(tools=...)` reveals when a Vercel AI frontend rebuilds history from the event stream by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10401
* Skip the gh-aw `pydantic-ai` engine when an earlier step wrote a `noop` to `GH_AW_SAFE_OUTPUTS` by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10450
* Restore the files #10457 accidentally reverted, including `request_timeout` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10483
* Update `RealtimeSession.context_window_used` together with the usage it reports by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10467
* Don't load the tokenizer to replay an empty GPT-Live history on a redial by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10474
* End an OpenAI realtime response created without an id when a malformed `response.done` closes it by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10511
* Call `OpenAIResponsesModel._process_provider_details` on streamed responses too by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10515
* Let shielded model-stream cleanup finish when an outer `anyio` cancel ends a debounced `stream_text()`, `stream_output()` or `stream_response()` by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10448
* Add `ModelProfile.tool_call_id_length` and rewrite tool call IDs that Mistral models reject by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10519
* Use automatic prompt caching (`anthropic_cache`) on `AsyncAnthropicVertex` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10513
* Inline GLM-5.3 tool schemas on Z.AI, Mistral, and OpenRouter by @2Zest in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10607
* Walk `propertyNames` and `contains` when inlining JSON Schema definitions by @jukebox in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10588
* Keep an unsaved `openai-codex` or `openai-chatgpt` token refresh instead of reverting to the stored credentials it spent by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10615
* Keep a request's separate `UserPromptPart`s through a `VercelAIAdapter` round trip by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10532
* Escape tool names in `CodeMode` discovery announcements and stop recognizing announcements by their text by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10559
* Keep every usage counter in `RunUsage.__sub__`, so durable runs keep one-hour cache writes and reasoning tokens, and declare `cache_write_1h_tokens` and `output_reasoning_tokens` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10516
* Don't ask again for a realtime tool batch's reply when the caller's `send()` of its last result failed by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10512
* Keep a request's separate `UserPromptPart`s through an `AGUIAdapter` round trip by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10563
* Stop continuing an OpenAI response with `openai_previous_response_id` once the history before it has changed by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10509
* Stop harness sub-agents from returning `DeferredToolRequests` to a parent that cannot resolve them by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10497
* Stop continuing an OpenAI response with `openai_previous_response_id` once the response itself has changed by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10656
* Raise `RealtimeError` instead of a raw `websockets` exception when a GPT-Live connection drops without a reconnect policy by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10645
* Ignore deeply nested `ReasoningMessage.encrypted_value` JSON in `AGUIAdapter.load_messages` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10650
* Write `format_as_xml` mapping keys that aren't valid XML names to a `key` attribute by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10651
* Fix `UseEnumMemberDocstrings` enums, `Choices` and `BoolCriteria` failing in Anthropic strict schemas by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10659
* Rewrite nested `$ref`s when merging JSON schema definitions by @limadog9 in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10601

## New Contributors
* @2Zest made their first contribution in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10607
* @jukebox made their first contribution in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10588
* @limadog9 made their first contribution in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10601

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/compare/v2.57.0...v2.58.0

name: v2.57.0 (2026-10-15)
body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at main -->

## What's Changed
### ⚠️ Compatibility Notes
* Attach namespaced `origin` and `tool_call_id` metadata to `BackgroundTools` completions by @michaeldunn9 in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10196
* Take GPT-Live realtime history, usage, and reply waits from the session core by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10083
* Honour `disable-model-invocation` and `user-invocable` in `Skills`, and skip stray skill library paths by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10378
* Take Gemini Live realtime history, usage, and reply waits from the session core by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10082
### 🚀 Features
* Add `MetaProvider` for Meta Muse models, with `meta:` using the Responses API by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10156
* Add Harness `ApprovalReviewer` to let a model approve low-risk tool calls before a person sees them by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10143
* Price requests at their reported service tier by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10244
* Add `dataset_name` to `EvaluationReport` by @jirikuncar in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10307
* Forward MCP Apps tool results to AG-UI and Vercel AI frontends and add `MCPToolset.read_resource_contents` by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10179
* Relay MCP Apps tool calls with `MCPToolset.call_tool_for_app` by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10190
### 🐛 Bug Fixes
* Fix token-based compaction retaining too little recent history by @AndrewTilson in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9784
* Record and stream one part per realtime output item when its transcript arrives late by [@pydanty](https://github.com/apps/pydanty) in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10097
* Reference multimodal URL choices in the `ToolReturnContent` discriminator mapping by @Kludex in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10239
* Stop `OpenAIResponsesModel` sending unavailable `tool_choice` names in `allowed_tools` by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10232
* Send Gemini tool-call thought signatures (`extra_content`) back from `OpenAIChatModel` by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10235
* Give a tool's `prepare` its own retry count under `.prefixed()`, `.renamed()` and `PrefixTools` by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10219
* Support Gemini agentic media processing in `GoogleModel` by @miguel-flowstate in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8028
* Stop granting native `tool_search` to `gpt-5.4-nano` by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10272
* Omit unset optional fields from Vercel AI `UIMessage` JSON so the AI SDK accepts it by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10175
* Keep `Planning` tool loops in the prompt cache, and attach a leading `CachePoint` to the previous user message on `OpenRouterModel` by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10257
* Release concurrency slots after streamed request cleanup by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10225
* Backfill an empty thinking field on current-turn tool calls in `OpenAIChatModel`'s default `'auto'` mode by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10251
* Keep `available_tool_names` and `active_capability_ids` on run context copies inside Temporal activities and Render child tasks by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10280
* Reconnect an xAI realtime session past `max_duration` when a `reconnect` policy is set by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10056
* Await `ProcessEventStream` cleanup after early exit and cancellation by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10341
* Count the request of a GPT-Live backend response that ends while the session closes by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10084
* Warn when `FallbackModel` response handlers are skipped on a streamed request by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10066
* Close the HTTP client of a model a run builds from a model name, and reuse one per name inside `async with agent:` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10067
* Make waits between continuation polls durable `DBOS.sleep` steps under `DBOSDurability` and `DBOSAgent` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10383
* Charge the partial response of an interrupted stream in `SpendLimits` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10069
* Stop `WarnNearLimits` from deleting user prompts that quote its `[WarnNearLimits]` marker by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10391

## New Contributors
* @AndrewTilson made their first contribution in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9784
* @miguel-flowstate made their first contribution in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8028
* @jirikuncar made their first contribution in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10307

name: v2.56.0 (2026-10-13)
body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at main -->

## What's Changed
### ⚠️ Compatibility Notes
* Run `BrowserUse` on the host model by default and make browser-use telemetry opt-in by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9506
### 🚀 Features
* Let `Skills` layer project and personal libraries, name each skill's directory, and render a skill for a host command by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9802
* Add `base_url` argument to `ZaiProvider` by @aisk in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10099
* Adds `PGTaskDurability` based on pgtask by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10174
* Adds Render Workflows Integration for Durable Execution engines  by @ojusave in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9439
* Remove `WarnNearLimits` from the harness `Coder` capability by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9969
* Add `SmolSandbox`: a workspace that runs harness capabilities in a local smolvm microVM by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10148
* Support Gemini 4 Argon (`gemini-4-argon`) on `GoogleModel` with long decode past the per-request output cap, and raise the Google providers' default timeout to 20 minutes by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10202
* Support Python 3.15 by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10064
### 🐛 Bug Fixes
* Keep a `send_audio()` chunk whose send fails out of the realtime `SpeechPart.audio` recorded while it was sending by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10058
* Explain the Bedrock data retention opt-in when Claude Fable 5 / 5.1 reject the default mode by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10050
* Apply `auth` to requests through `MCPToolset(http_client=...)` and stop closing the user-supplied client by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10051
* Allow list-form `tool_choice` to name output tools, and accept static lists that include one by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8565
* Raise `ModelAPIError` when a 200 response from OpenAI Responses, Anthropic, Groq or OpenAI images has a `text/plain` body by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10065
* Stop sending explicit prompt caching fields to the `openai-codex` backend by @aisk in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10103
* Use `openai-decisions` pricing before matching the shared OpenAI base URL by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10122
* Unwrap decorated partials when inferring evaluation task names by [@pydanty](https://github.com/apps/pydanty) in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10121
* Stop harness context estimates double-counting changed instructions and tool-returned files by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9929
* Support adjustable reasoning on `mistral-large-4` and `mistral-large-4-0` by [@pydanty](https://github.com/apps/pydanty) in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9967
* Map every `UsageLimits` field to an explicit ACP stop reason by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9497
* Record native tool events in `gh-aw` sessions by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10000
* Retry stale thinking blocks with `drop_block` when Bedrock rejects them by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9486
* Fix `import pydantic_ai.models` on Pyodide by skipping the eager `httpcore2` import on Emscripten by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10134
* Replay xAI server-side tool results as tool turns paired with their calls by @kevinwmerritt in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10043

name: v2.53.0 (2026-10-01)
body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at main -->

### 🛡️ Security

This release fixes one security issue in `ConcurrencyLimitedModel`. See the advisory for full details and affected versions.

- **[GHSA-6fqq-452j-qhrp](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/security/advisories/GHSA-6fqq-452j-qhrp)** (high): a streamed request through `ConcurrencyLimitedModel` or `limit_model_concurrency` could keep its concurrency slot when the slot was released on a different task than the one that acquired it: after an early exit (the consumer stopped iterating, raised, or was cancelled), and also after fully consuming `stream_text()` with its default debouncing. Repeated streams could then block every request sharing the limiter. Agent-level `max_concurrency` and non-streaming requests are not affected. Reported by @lche511. (#9478)

The fix also changes how limiters are shared: a model wrapper now raises `UserError` when it shares a limiter with the agent making the request or with an enclosing model wrapper, `ConcurrencyLimiter.acquire()` takes a slot on every call, even on the same task, and a custom `AbstractConcurrencyLimiter` must allow `release()` from another task.

Patched in `2.53.0`. v1 is not affected.

## What's Changed
### ⚠️ Compatibility Notes
* Add `oneOf` schema support to `TestModel`'s generated data by [@pydanty](https://github.com/apps/pydanty) in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8783
* Deprecate `pydantic_ai_harness.step_persistence.naming` by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9499
### 🚀 Features
* Count Google grounding web search queries in `usage` by [@pydanty](https://github.com/apps/pydanty) in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8891
* Add `AbsurdDurability` to the harness as a replacement for `pydantic-ai-absurd` by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8946
* Let `AskUser` defer questions to the host and time out a slow answerer by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9509
* Add `SystemOneModel` to run decision models such as CLM and Laya over the `/v1/systemone` API by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8942
* Add `ToolCallJudge` to assess tool calls before execution by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9041
* Send images and documents from GPT-Live tool results to the delegated backend by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9048
* Expose the message-history repair pipeline as `repair_messages` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8370
### 🐛 Bug Fixes
* Kill the process group when a `LocalWorkspaceBackend.run` timeout fires during process startup by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9358
* Avoid invalid-escape warning floods during `CodeMode` analysis by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9475
* Keep the registered `Memory` toolset across runs so durable execution accepts it by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9489
* Keep the registered `Planning` toolset across runs so durable execution accepts it by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9507
* Keep planted files from escaping `BubblewrapSandbox` on the next launch by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9457
* Render non-finite eval metrics as `inf`/`-inf`/`nan` by [@pydanty](https://github.com/apps/pydanty) in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8852
* Snap `gemini-3.1-flash-image` thinking efforts to `minimal` and `high` on the Gemini API by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9515
* Raise `UnexpectedModelBehavior` instead of running the wrong tool when function tool calls share a `tool_call_id` by [@pydanty](https://github.com/apps/pydanty) in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8782
* Build one streamed `XaiModel` thinking part per output, matching the non-streamed response by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9416
* Leave image generation calls out of the `OpenAIResponsesModel` replay when `openai_store=False` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9388
* Build the same `ModelResponse` from streamed and complete `OpenAIChatModel` and `OpenRouterModel` responses by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9418
* Make `OpenAIResponsesModel` build the same `ModelResponse` from a stream as from a complete response by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9417
* Make xAI push-to-talk reply only when asked: `commit_audio()` alone no longer triggers a reply, and `create_response()` is always answered by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9070
* Tolerate OpenAI realtime `status`, `status_details` and session values the SDK does not know yet by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9392
* Stop `SubAgents` from forcing `thinking` on disk agents by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9384
* Restore `DynamicWorkflow` reveal announcements after compaction or history loss by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9371
* Make Logfire Temporal spans replay-safe by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/7006
* Allow unschemable types in the derived Temporal `ActivityConfig` schema by [@pydanty](https://github.com/apps/pydanty) in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9577
* Let `GoogleRealtimeModel` declare tools whose `dict` values are recursive models by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9607

name: v2.52.0 (2026-09-29)
body:
### 🛡️ Security

This release fixes one security issue in `web_fetch`. See the advisory for full details and affected versions.

- **[GHSA-v36g-jcw9-x7cw](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/security/advisories/GHSA-v36g-jcw9-x7cw)** (moderate): converting attacker-controlled HTML with deeply nested elements in the local `web_fetch` tool could consume excessive CPU and memory. Provider-native web fetching is not affected. Reported by @SounLabs. (#8984)

Patched in `2.52.0` (v2) and `1.107.7` (v1).

### 📦 Harness

`pydantic-ai-harness` now lives in this repository and ships with every Pydantic AI release, so it jumps from `0.36.0` to `0.52.0`.

## What's Changed
### ⚠️ Compatibility Notes
* Run harness capabilities in any workspace: `Coder`, `FileSystem`, `Shell` and the rest work through `ctx.workspace`, locally or in a sandbox by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8866
* Replace `ModalSandbox`'s own tools with a Modal workspace, so `Coder`, `Shell` and `FileSystem` run in the sandbox; `ModalSandboxBackend` replaces `ModalSandboxSession` by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8867
* Raise `AnthropicModel`'s default `max_tokens` from 4096 to 16384 on Claude Sonnet 4.5 and later by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9025
* Keep the prompt as a `DecisionModel`'s judged `text` after a retry by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8967
* Stop `SubAgents` loading agent files by default, and deprecate `inherit_tools` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9023
* Default `AnthropicModel`'s `max_tokens` to the model's maximum output, streaming such requests behind the scenes by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9298
### 🚀 Features
* Add workspaces: `ctx.workspace` gives tools one API for files and commands, on your machine or in a sandbox, with durable execution support by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/6492
* Add `SpritesSandbox`: a workspace that runs `Coder`, `Shell`, `FileSystem` and every other harness capability in a Fly.io Sprite by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8869
* Add `E2BSandbox`: a workspace that runs `Coder`, `Shell`, `FileSystem` and every other harness capability in an E2B sandbox by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8868
* Give `Coder` file tools a retry budget of 5 and keep scratch files out of the project by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8970
* Add Claude Sonnet 5.5 (`claude-sonnet-5-5`) support by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8974
* Model realtime async tool calls as a profile `async_tool_call_mode` with a shared `async_tool_calls` setting by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8813
* Add `_process_provider_details` hook to `OpenAIResponsesModel` by [@pydanty](https://github.com/apps/pydanty) in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9094
* Seed retained user audio on Gemini `gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview` and `gemini-3.8-live` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9047
* Support browser WebRTC on OpenAI GPT-Live with `answer_webrtc_offer` and a sideband session by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9059
* Add `SSHWorkspace` and `BubblewrapSandbox` harness capabilities by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8956
* Add `azure_voice_live_voice` to choose an Azure voice for Azure AI Voice Live sessions by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9044
* Apply `thinking`, `openai_turn_detection`, `openai_input_noise_reduction` and a new `azure_voice_live_temperature` on Azure AI Voice Live by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9051
* Seed tool calls and results as native function parts on Gemini `gemini-3.8-live` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9058
* Emit identified response, turn, and input lifecycle events from the OpenAI-protocol realtime connection by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9064
* Warn on unexpected `RequestUsage.extract()` failures by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8564
* feat(profiles): `default_cache_retention` + `prompt_cache_outlook()` cold-window helper; rename `resolve_prompt_cache_retention()` to `resolve_cache_retention()` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/6337
* Deliver images and text files returned from tools on Gemini 3.x Live by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9065
* Map the shared `thinking` and `parallel_tool_calls` settings to the GPT-Live backend model by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9040
* Accept `mxfp4`, `nvfp4`, and `mxfp8` OpenRouter `quantizations` and the `exacto` `sort` value by @harimaruthachalam in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8888
* Add OpenAI `gpt-6.1-sol` model support and allow image output on `gpt-6-astra` by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9305
### 🐛 Bug Fixes
* Record realtime user turns in speaking order under push-to-talk, barge-in, and with input transcription off by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8764
* Stop tool docstring parsing from changing the root logger level by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8872
* Treat `application/toml` as text-like for inline model inputs by @JoeyTan21 in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8848
* Ask for one answer per batch of parallel realtime tool results, and stop `wait_for_reply()` hanging on merged or failed replies by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8765
* Move tool-forcing and thinking-default profile flags to `ModelProfile` so they apply on every provider route by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8808
* Stop Gemini Live tool rounds reporting `RealtimeTurnCompleteEvent` before the spoken answer by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8766
* Don't force output tools on Anthropic requests that think, so Claude keeps thinking with a structured `output_type` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8812
* Truncate the provider's copy of a realtime reply the user cut off after it finished generating by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8757
* Leave room for the extended thinking budget in Anthropic's default `max_tokens` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8986
* Settle Gemini tool calls and 2.5 typed turns a resumed realtime session lost, and stop OpenAI-protocol reconnects re-requesting a failed `response.create` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8763
* Keep a realtime microphone task alive across a reconnect by dropping audio sent while the link is re-dialed by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8806
* Raise `UserError` instead of `ModelRetry` for `Macroscope` setup failures by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8999
* Give the first stage of a Playwright operation its full configured budget by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9029
* Make workspace concurrency deadlines robust under load by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9043
* Report OpenAI native web searches in `RequestUsage.details` and price them in `cost` by @dltsum in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8310
* Apply model concurrency limits to `compact_messages()` by @yang0228 in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8241
* Allow `azure_voice_live=True` for `gpt-realtime-2` models on `AzureRealtimeModel` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9050
* Bound the Gemini Live handshake with `handshake_timeout` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9042
* Allow text output on Vertex `gemini-live-2.5-flash` and remove a stale Gemini Live docs claim by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9069
* Emit `DeferredToolRequestsEvent` in realtime sessions before the `HandleDeferredToolCalls` handler runs by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9057
* Map OpenAI response JSON decode errors to `ModelAPIError` by [@pydanty](https://github.com/apps/pydanty) in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8846
* Map in-stream error objects to `ModelAPIError` in `OpenAIChatModel`, `GroqModel` and `HuggingFaceModel` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9313
* Raise `ModelAPIError` instead of `ValidationError` when an `OpenRouterModel` stream drops mid-response by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9312
* Read the `capabilities` docs topic from `capabilities/overview.md` in `PydanticAIDocs` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9011
* Apply `FileSystem` default `read_only_patterns` to nested `.env` and `.git/` paths by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9021
* Restore `CodeMode` discovery announcements after compaction or history loss by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9045
* Keep the original request in the `TrajectoryJudge` window when the transcript is clamped by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9012
* Raise `ContentFilterError` for a thinking-only response refused by the content filter, instead of retrying by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9355
* Sandbox file methods and block sockets without network in `BubblewrapSandbox` by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9349
* Give the current time to the hour in `LogfireMCP` instructions so they stop busting the prompt cache by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9319
* Raise `ModelAPIError` when the OpenAI Responses API reports a failed response or an `error` stream event by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9321
* Map every `MistralError` from the Mistral SDK to `ModelHTTPError` or `ModelAPIError` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9307
* Map provider errors from `GoogleModel.count_tokens` and `XaiModel` file uploads by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9308
* Fix capability audit findings in `ClampOversizedMessages`, `SubAgents`, and `StepPersistence` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9026
* Root union output member `data` validation errors under `result.data` so retry feedback keeps the failing input by [@pydanty](https://github.com/apps/pydanty) in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8669
* Read a `shell` job log deleted mid-read as empty instead of failing the call by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9322
* Record Gemini Live `turn_complete_reason` as the realtime response's `finish_reason` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9390
* Remove the default ACP `request_limit` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9380
* Report a realtime session's own usage on its span, not a carried total by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9389
* Count separately budgeted `SubAgent` usage toward parent budgets by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9374

name: v2.50.0 (2026-09-24)
body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at main -->

## What's Changed
### ⚠️ Compatibility Notes
* Ask a `DecisionModel` which route to take by name, with one label per route by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8733
* Make `ModelSelectionContext.messages` end with the request being routed, and add `ModelSelectionContext.prompt` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8737
* Replace the decision model's tool-call lean with an opt-in `decision_route_threshold` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8739
### 🚀 Features
* Expose OpenAI `service_tier` in provider details by [@pydanty](https://github.com/apps/pydanty) in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/7945
* Add `DecisionModel`, a base for Decisions-protocol models, and make `TypeSafeModel` one by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8696
* Add `RunContext.in_durable_context` so hooks can tell they run in durable workflow code by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8723
* Add `gemini-3.8-live` and `gemini-3.8-live-extended-thinking` realtime support by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8393
* Ask a `DecisionModel`'s route fields with the route question under a route premise, with nested-field `context` and a `done` state after tool calls by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8749
* Emit a `decide` span for every request a `DecisionModel` sends by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8698
### 🐛 Bug Fixes
* Keep the type variable of a generic `OutputSpec[T]` passed to `Agent.run` under mypy by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8730
* Send `ThinkingPart`s in the history decision models judge by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8738
* Price Anthropic one-hour cache writes at the one-hour rate instead of the five-minute rate by @kazmer97 in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8666
* Price realtime image input at the image rate by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8741
* Add `RequestUsage.audio_seconds` so duration-billed voice models are priced by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8427
* Offer a decision model's unfillable `output_type` as a route beside other routes, and rename `ToolCallProposed` to `UnfillableRoute` under a `DecisionHandOff` base by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8744
* Keep realtime user turns whole when the microphone streams continuously on providers without input item IDs by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8746
* Roll back a realtime send the provider refuses, so `wait_for_reply()` no longer hangs on it by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8747
* Turn reasoning off for `thinking=False` on OpenAI Realtime by sending `reasoning.effort: 'none'` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8753
* Take Jev's `context_window` from genai-prices and document compacting a Jev conversation by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8740
* Buffer five minutes of audio per `stream_audio()` view so speaker-paced playback gets whole replies by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8750
* Stop Google Search from crashing Gemini 2.5 native-audio realtime sessions by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8751
* Keep user speech out of Gemini 3.x realtime history when input transcription is off by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8754
* Surface a failed OpenAI realtime response's error as a `RealtimeSessionErrorEvent` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8752


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/compare/v2.49.0...v2.50.0

name: v2.44.0 (2026-09-16)
body:
### 🛡️ Security

This release fixes four security issues, all of them reached through `web_fetch_tool` or OpenTelemetry instrumentation. See each advisory for full details and affected versions.

- **[GHSA-vmxc-h2x2-jmf3](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/security/advisories/GHSA-vmxc-h2x2-jmf3)** (moderate): the cloud-metadata and private-IP blocklists could be bypassed with an IPv6 zone identifier on a URL opted into local network access, via `FileUrl(force_download='allow-local')` or `web_fetch_tool(allow_local_urls=True)`. Both are off by default. Reported by @euriconicacio. (#8401)
- **[GHSA-fpf4-vwcp-v4hp](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/security/advisories/GHSA-fpf4-vwcp-v4hp)** (moderate): `web_fetch` processed responses in superlinear time on the event loop, in both the HTML conversion and the charset decode, so a single attacker-chosen page could stall every agent in the process. Reported by @BrianWillows. (#8397, #8418, #8433)
- **[GHSA-22h6-qm39-v87j](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/security/advisories/GHSA-22h6-qm39-v87j)** (low): `web_fetch_tool`'s domain lists were compared as written rather than in the form the resolver uses, so a blocked domain could be reached under another spelling. (#8407, #8421)
- **[GHSA-4x9p-g9wm-8q7f](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/security/advisories/GHSA-4x9p-g9wm-8q7f)** (low): with `InstrumentationSettings(include_content=False)`, spans still carried exceptions, error statuses, instructions and the output template. Reported by @BrianWillows. (#8403, #8408, #8419, #8428)

Patched in `2.44.0` (v2) and `1.107.6` (v1).


## What's Changed
### ⚠️ Compatibility Notes
* Make `RunContext.enqueue()` safe from worker threads by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/7758
* Require a JSON `Content-Type` on UI adapter requests by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8396
* Dispatch a capability `@durable_operation` called from a per-request hook, instead of silently running it inline by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8395
### 🚀 Features
* Add a Vercel AI SDK and Eve migration skill by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8357
* Give `AgentRunResult` a stable serialized shape, and settle a finished stream into one by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8269
* Add a `Storage` page so persistence is findable by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8336
* Emit `EnqueuedMessagesEvent` when a realtime session delivers enqueued content by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8134
### 🐛 Bug Fixes
* Forward `blocked_domains` to OpenAI web search by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8323
* Fix OpenAI hosted `tool_search` pairing in AG-UI by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8313
* Let `Agent.from_spec()` construct without a model, deferring the requirement to run time by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8339
* Let `RealtimeSession.close()` finish its teardown when the closing task is cancelled by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8142
* Run a capability's `prepare_tools` over every tool the availability gate admits by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8071

name: v1.107.6 (2026-09-16)
body:
### 🛡️ Security

A maintenance release for the v1 line, carrying the v1 backports of the four security fixes released in `2.44.0`. See each advisory for full details and affected versions.

- **[GHSA-vmxc-h2x2-jmf3](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/security/advisories/GHSA-vmxc-h2x2-jmf3)** (moderate): cloud-metadata and private-IP blocklist bypass via an IPv6 zone identifier, on a URL opted into local network access. Reported by @euriconicacio. (#8402)
- **[GHSA-fpf4-vwcp-v4hp](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/security/advisories/GHSA-fpf4-vwcp-v4hp)** (moderate): superlinear response processing in `web_fetch`, in both the HTML conversion and the charset decode, blocking the event loop. Reported by @BrianWillows. (#8399, #8434)
- **[GHSA-22h6-qm39-v87j](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/security/advisories/GHSA-22h6-qm39-v87j)** (low): `web_fetch_tool` domain lists compared as written rather than in the form the resolver uses. (#8409)
- **[GHSA-4x9p-g9wm-8q7f](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/security/advisories/GHSA-4x9p-g9wm-8q7f)** (low): OpenTelemetry spans carrying exceptions, error statuses, instructions and the output template under `include_content=False`. Reported by @BrianWillows. (#8404, #8422, #8429)

Also carried over: credentials are now dropped on a `safe_download` redirect whenever the full origin changes, not only the hostname (#8410). This was fixed on the v2 line some time ago and had never been backported.

Patched in `1.107.6`; all four are also patched on the v2 line in `2.44.0`.

## What's Changed

Every code change in this release is one of the security fixes above. Maintenance alongside them:

* Repair `v1` CI and its `mcp`, `anthropic`, and `duckduckgo` extras (v1 backport) by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8406
* Pin FastA2A below 1 in the `a2a` extra (v1) by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8412

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/compare/v1.107.5...v1.107.6

body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at main -->

## ⚠️ If Anthropic stopped working for you in the last day

`anthropic` 1.0.0 — rebuilt on `httpx2`, with legacy `httpx` support removed — reached PyPI on August 20. Every earlier pydantic-ai release, including v2.32.2 cut a few hours before this one, allowed that version without supporting it: a fresh or unpinned install of `pydantic-ai[anthropic]` could resolve `anthropic` 1.0.0 and then fail at runtime when using an Anthropic model. Apologies for the breakage window.

- **Fix**: upgrade to `pydantic-ai` v2.33.0, which requires and supports `anthropic>=1.0.0`.
- **If you need to stay on an older pydantic-ai**: pin `anthropic<1`.

If you pass your own `http_client` to `AnthropicProvider`, it must now be an `httpx2.AsyncClient` — the 1.x SDK rejects legacy `httpx` clients at construction.

name: v1.107.4 (2026-08-11)
body:
> **Note:** an earlier `v1.107.3` tag/release was cut and deleted tonight — a build-tooling issue ([#7394](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/7394): `hatchling` 1.32.0 emitted a package-metadata version PyPI's publish validator didn't yet accept) blocked its publish before anything reached PyPI, so nothing under that version number was ever installable. This release (`1.107.4`) carries the same fixes with the build issue resolved.

### 🛡️ Security

This release backports two security fixes to the v1 line:

- **[GHSA-h4xc-3qfq-jf93](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/security/advisories/GHSA-h4xc-3qfq-jf93)** (high) — the development web chat UI's (`Agent.to_web()`, `clai web`) chat endpoint didn't check the request's content type, so a plain cross-origin request from a website open in the developer's browser could reach it without a CORS preflight and trigger the served agent to run and execute its tools with the local process's privileges and credentials. The endpoint now requires `Content-Type: application/json`.
- **[GHSA-3gh4-cghq-f8v4](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/security/advisories/GHSA-3gh4-cghq-f8v4)** (low) — retry-prompt content wasn't redacted by `InstrumentationSettings(include_content=False)` when the retry wasn't tied to a tool call.

Patched in `1.107.4`; both are also patched on the v2 line (`2.28.0` and `2.27.1` respectively).

* Backport #7357 to `v1` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/7381
* Only accept JSON request bodies on the web UI chat endpoint (v1 backport) by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/7383

name: v2.28.0 (2026-08-11)

### 🛡️ Security

Fixes a high-severity vulnerability in the development web chat UI (`Agent.to_web()`, `clai web`): the chat endpoint didn't check the request's content type, so a plain cross-origin request from a website open in the developer's browser could reach the endpoint without a CORS preflight and trigger the served agent to run and execute its tools with the local process's privileges and credentials. ### 🛡️ Security

Patched versions enforce a default 50 MiB download cap. See [GHSA-v2xh-2vp8-57h8](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/security/advisories/GHSA-v2xh-2vp8-57h8). Patched in `1.107.2` (v1) and `2.24.0` (v2).

name: v1.107.1 (2026-07-10)
body:
## What's Changed

### 🛡️ Security

This release patches **[GHSA-jpr8-2v3g-wgf9](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/security/advisories/GHSA-jpr8-2v3g-wgf9)** (moderate, CWE-863) on the v1 line. On the AG-UI serving path (`Agent.to_ag_ui()` / `AGUIAdapter`), `UIAdapter.sanitize_messages` anchored its dangling-tool-call strip to an index computed before sanitization. When a trailing client message was dropped during sanitization (for example a client `system` message under the default `manage_system_prompt='server'`), a preceding assistant response carrying an unresolved tool call could be re-exposed as the new tail and executed with client-chosen arguments.

- **Affected**: `pydantic-ai` / `pydantic-ai-slim` `>= 1.88.0, < 1.107.1` (v1) and `>= 2.0.0, < 2.5.0` (v2)
- **Patched**: `1.107.1` (v1) and `2.5.0` (v2)
- **Not affected** if every sensitive tool uses `requires_approval=True` / `ApprovalRequiredToolset`, or if your tool handlers validate their arguments and enforce authorization themselves.

See the [advisory](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/security/advisories/GHSA-jpr8-2v3g-wgf9) for details and workarounds.

body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at main -->

## What's Changed

### 🛡️ Security

This release included the fix for **[GHSA-jpr8-2v3g-wgf9](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/security/advisories/GHSA-jpr8-2v3g-wgf9)** (moderate, CWE-863), carried by the `sanitize_messages` change in #6169. On the AG-UI serving path (`Agent.to_ag_ui()` / `AGUIAdapter`), the dangling-tool-call strip anchored to a pre-sanitization index, so a dropped trailing client message could re-expose a preceding unresolved tool call for execution. The v1 line is patched in `1.107.1`.

- **Patched**: `2.5.0` (v2) and `1.107.1` (v1)
- **Affected**: `>= 2.0.0, < 2.5.0` (v2) and `>= 1.88.0, < 1.107.1` (v1)

### 🚀 Features

name: v2.0.0 (2026-06-23)
body:
# 🎉 Pydantic AI V2.0 is here!

After seven betas, **Pydantic AI V2 is now stable.** V2 leans into a harness-first design with [capabilities](https://ai.pydantic.dev/capabilities/) as a core primitive — a single composable unit that bundles an agent's tools, hooks, instructions, and model settings, reaching every layer of the agent through one concept.

Install it with:

```bash
uv add pydantic-ai
```

See the [Upgrade Guide](https://ai.pydantic.dev/changelog/) for everything that's changed and the recommended path from V1.

---
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at main -->

## What's Changed
### 🚀 Features
* Add `gemini-embedding-2` embedding model by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/5887

# 🚀 Pydantic AI V2 Beta 7 is here!

For more information on Pydantic AI V2, see the [release notes](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/releases/tag/v2.0.0b1) for `v2.0.0b1` and the [Upgrade Guide](https://fb946b86-pydantic-ai-previews.pydantic.workers.dev/changelog/).

Beta 7 adds no new breaking or v2-specific changes, but pulls in these changes from [v1.107.0](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/releases/tag/v1.107.0):

## What's Changed
### 🛡️ Security
* Handle `UploadedFile` consistently with `FileUrl` in UI adapters by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/5772
	* Security advisory: `VercelAIAdapter` trusts client-controlled provider metadata to construct `UploadedFile` references (confused-deputy file read) https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/security/advisories/GHSA-h7p7-w5gc-xj3w
	* This fix went out in [v1.106.0](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/releases/tag/v1.106.0) and [v2.0.0b6](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/releases/tag/v2.0.0b6).
	* You are affected **only** if your application passes untrusted client-submitted message history to an agent through a UI adapter (e.g. `VercelAIAdapter`), **AND** your model-provider or cloud-storage account holds files referenceable by an attacker-guessable `UploadedFile` id or storage URI (e.g. `s3://…`, `gs://…`).
	* You are **not** affected if you do not pass untrusted client-submitted message history to the agent, or you strip `UploadedFile` parts before running it.
	* You are **not** affected via `AGUIAdapter` / `Agent.to_ag_ui` on defaults — the `preserve_file_data` flag that re-enables this path is off by default.
### 🚀 Features
* Add `known_model_names()` to enumerate `KnownModelName` members by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/5803
* feat(openrouter): add `CachePoint` and prompt caching support by @Adversarian in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/4604
* Add Claude Fable 5 (`claude-fable-5`) and Claude Mythos 5 (`claude-mythos-5`) support by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/5849
### 🐛 Bug Fixes
* fix(anthropic): guard `message=None` Bedrock start events in stream path by @Bartok9 in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/5818
* Fix `AnthropicModel.count_tokens` with native tools by @kazmer97 in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/5704
### 📦 Dependencies
* chore(deps): bump the python-packages group across 1 directory with 18 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/5768

## New Contributors
* @Bartok9 made their first contribution in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/5818
* @kazmer97 made their first contribution in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/5704


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/compare/v2.0.0b6...v2.0.0b7

# 🚀 Pydantic AI V2 Beta 4 is here!

For more information on Pydantic AI V2, see the [Upgrade Guide](https://9a6d6eb5-pydantic-ai-previews.pydantic.workers.dev/changelog/).

Beta 4 turns the V1 deprecation warning for prepare-callback `None` returns into a hard `TypeError`, and pulls in two V1 releases on top — [v1.103.0](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/releases/tag/v1.103.0) and [v1.104.0](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/releases/tag/v1.104.0):

### 🚀 Features
* Add `list_prompts` and `get_prompt` functionality to `McpServer` by @bdore in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/3889
* Round-trip message timestamps through `VercelAIAdapter`'s `UIMessage.metadata` by @Genmin in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/5279
* Support `anthropic_eager_input_streaming` in `OpenRouterModel` by @Alex-Resch in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/5656

* fix(toolsets): warn when prepare callbacks return `None` by @dfm88 in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/5188
* Forward `thinking=False` on hybrid OpenRouter/xAI/Bedrock routes, aligning silent-drop with direct routes by @sarth6 in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/5433

name: v2.0.0b1 (2026-05-20)
body:
## 🚀 Pydantic AI V2 Beta 1 is here!

V2 leans into a **harness-first** design, with [capabilities](https://fa663546-pydantic-ai-previews.pydantic.workers.dev/capabilities/) as a core primitive. A capability is a single, composable unit that bundles an agent's tools, lifecycle hooks, instructions, and model settings — so a whole extension (a memory system, a guardrail, a coding toolkit) can reach every layer of the agent through one concept you pass via `capabilities=[...]`. Pydantic AI stays a small core: some capabilities ship with it, more come from the first-party [Pydantic AI Harness](https://fa663546-pydantic-ai-previews.pydantic.workers.dev/harness/overview/), and others are third-party or your own.

Many of V2's changes move configuration that used to be spread across `Agent` arguments onto that primitive, alongside the behavior changes V1's stability guarantee didn't allow.

### How do I get it?

V2.0.0b1 is forked from [**v1.100.0**](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/releases/tag/v1.100.0) (out today), which (along with other recent versions) deprecates most of what V2 removes. The recommended path (full before → after in the [Upgrade Guide](https://fa663546-pydantic-ai-previews.pydantic.workers.dev/changelog/)):

1. Upgrade to **v1.100.0** and clear every deprecation warning — point a coding agent at them; this covers the bulk of the migration.
2. Install the beta and review the behavior changes below.

```bash
uv add 'pydantic-ai==2.0.0b1'
```

### Behavior changes to review (these can't be surfaced by a deprecation warning)

- A bare `pydantic-ai` install now ships fewer extras — add providers like `bedrock`, `groq`, `mistral` explicitly.
- `openai:` model names now use the OpenAI Responses API; use `openai-chat:` to stay on Chat Completions.
- `WebSearch`/`WebFetch` are native-only by default, and `MCP(url=...)` runs locally by default.
- Default instrumentation is version 5, with aggregated token-usage span attributes.
- `capture_run_messages()` now also captures partial messages from interrupted runs.
- Function tools requested alongside a successful output tool now run by default (`end_strategy='graceful'`) instead of being skipped.

Most other removals were deprecated by v1.100.0; the [Upgrade Guide](https://fa663546-pydantic-ai-previews.pydantic.workers.dev/changelog/) has the complete list, split into changes covered vs. not covered by deprecation warnings.

It's a pre-release — stable V2.0 is expected within roughly two weeks — so pin the exact `b` version and expect occasional changes before then. 

[File issues](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/issues) or chat in [Slack](https://ai.pydantic.dev/help/).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/compare/v1.100.0...v2.0.0b1

## Selected Features since v1.0.0
* Support image generation and output with Google and OpenAI by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/2970
* Add Pydantic AI Gateway provider by @Kludex in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/2816, https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/2863

* Support text, JSON, XML and YAML `DocumentUrl` and `BinaryContent` on OpenAI by @pulphix in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/2851
* Added MCP metadata and annotations to `ToolDefinition.metadata` for use in filtering by @ChuckJonas in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/2880

* Support contextually overriding agent `instructions` by @mwildehahn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/2926
* Tools can now return AG-UI events separate from result sent to model by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/2922
* Add `AgentRunResult.response` convenience method to get latest model response by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/2970
* Add `ModelResponse.text`, `thinking`, `files`, `images`, `tool_calls`, and `builtin_tool_calls` convenience methods by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/2970
* Add `Agent.run_stream_events()` convenience method wrapping `run(event_stream_handler=...)` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/3084

## Other Changes in v1.1.0
* Record instructions on the agent run span even when they are dynamic by @dmontagu in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/3131

name: v1.0.1 (2025-09-05)
body:
## Breaking Changes

The following breaking change was slated to go into v1.0.0 but accidentally left out. Because it's a security issue, an uncommonly used feature, and few people will have updated to v1 yet within 24 hours, we decided it was justified to make an exception to the no-breaking-changes policy to get it out ASAP.

* Remove `Python` evaluator from `pydantic_evals` for security reasons by @dmontagu in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/2808

* Let almost all types used in docs examples be imported directly from `pydantic_ai` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/2736

* Remove cases and averages from eval span by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/2715
* Make many more dataclasses kw-only by @dmontagu in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/2738

* Close original response when retrying HTTP request by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/2753
* `Agent.__aenter__` returns `Self`, use default instrumentation for MCP sampling model by @alexmojaki in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/2765
* Fix Anthropic streaming usage counting by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/2771
* Create separate `ThinkingParts` for separate OpenAI Responses reasoning summary parts by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/2775

name: v0.3.0 (2025-06-18)
body:
## Breaking Changes

See [#1142](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/1142) — Adds support for thinking parts.

We now convert the thinking blocks (`"<think>..."</think>"`) in provider specific text parts to
PydanticAI `ThinkingPart`s. Also, as part of this release, we made the choice to not send back the
`ThinkingPart`s to the provider - the idea is to save costs on behalf of the user. In the future, we
intend to add a setting to customize this behavior.

name: v0.2.0 (2025-05-12)
body:
## Breaking Changes
See [#1647](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/1647) — usage makes sense as part of `ModelResponse`, and could be really useful in "messages" (really a sequence of requests and response). In this PR:

* Adds `usage` to `ModelResponse` (field has a default factory of `Usage()` so it'll work to load data that doesn't have usage)
* changes the return type of `Model.request` to just `ModelResponse` instead of `tuple[ModelResponse, Usage]`

## Other Changes
* Add support for non-string enums in Gemini by @zaidhaan in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/1564
* Fix parallel tool calls on Bedrock with Nova and Claude models by @pandersen-uncharted in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/1656
* Fix Anthropic streaming by @samuelcolvin in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/1686
* Fix serializability of ModelRequestParameters by @dmontagu in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/1690
* Stop incorrectly treating side-by-side JSON schema $refs as recursion by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/1697
* Set `ToolCallPartDelta.tool_call_id` when known from previous delta by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/1694

## New Contributors
